anchor_value: Rendered source schedule presents amortized cost and fair value in dollars

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Portfolio Company (1) | Investment Type | Reference Rate and Spread (2) | Floor | Interest Rate (2) | Initial Acquisition Date | Maturity Date | Par/Shares | Amortized Cost (3) | Fair Value (4) | % of Net Assets (17) | Footnotes

rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw source schedule renders the affected BDC valuation columns as dollar-denominated. The table header identifies Amortized Cost and Fair Value, individual rows show dollar-sign cells before par, amortized cost, and fair value, and the schedule total is also dollar-denominated. U_USD is therefore a unit-label normalization artifact rather than source evidence of non-USD valuation fields.
